name: LIFECYCLE_GATE
reason: Serializes TinyMCP open/close transitions, which the module admits one at a time process-wide; it guards no data and carries no tenant state.

name: REGISTRY
reason: Keyed by a random per-remix correlation id; each entry holds the registering caller's config, CoreContext and memory identity, which every callback re-enters. Callbacks are accepted only from the module peer (bus name owner) for a live id, and the entry is retired by End, a failed call, or an age sweep.

name: FOREGROUND
reason: Holds only unit mutexes. The key is the workspace directory plus the acting memory identity, so different scopes never share or wait on a lock and no tenant data is stored.

name: MEMORY
reason: Process-local in-memory attachment fallback only for the CLI/direct/test path without init_attachments_dir; the host path uses the initialized workspace-backed stash instead. Avoids persisting bytes or credentials on disk and is never selected for initialized service workspaces.
verification: agent/multimodal.rs: stash() selects workspace-scoped attachment_stash_for(workspace) when ATTACHMENTS_DIR is initialized; memory_stash() is the explicitly ephemeral uninitialized fallback. Never expose a shared fallback for multi-tenant services.

name: BUILTIN_CLOUD_PROVIDERS
reason: Immutable process-wide provider preset definitions converted from upstream builtin declarations plus host-owned presets. Contains no account, workspace, token or user data.
verification: config/schema/cloud_providers_tests.rs: built-in provider contracts; cloud_providers.rs constructs the table solely from constants.

name: REG
reason: Single-process suppression of repeated provider credential errors by provider slug; contains transient in-memory error states but no credential bytes. API consumers must keep this single-user diagnostic state out of multi-tenant authorization decisions.
verification: inference/auth_error_registry.rs records and clears failed episodes by provider; no authenticated token values are stored in this structure.

name: RESOLVER
reason: Process-wide model context-window estimate cache keyed by provider/model; holds numeric token-window hints rather than user prompts, tokens or individual messages.
verification: inference/context_window.rs: remembered_window(provider, model) delegates to tinyinference-llm resolver; no credentials are passed to the cache.

name: DONE
reason: Deduplicates successful legacy module imports per importer type, module-scope identity and absolute data directory, using an async gate. A cancelled or failed import is not cached.
verification: modules/mod.rs: import_once caches (kind, module_id, directory) only after a settled successful import.
